headline: Clashes Flare in Mooring County as Linn of Mercy Sees Sudden Warden Push
war_summary: Since our last report, Colonial counter-thrusts have reopened the contest in Mooring County, seizing back two strategic outposts amid rapid localized exchanges. Violence across the Weathered Expanse continues unabated at a furious tempo, claiming over 3,600 casualties within the past two hours while leaving three strategic positions neutralized between the lines. In the Linn of Mercy, frontline combat has surged violently, with over 2,600 casualties logged in the last two hours as Warden forces stormed and captured the stronghold of Lathair. Fresh skirmishing has simultaneously erupted across Marban Hollow, where repeated clashes around Checkpoint Bua leave two positions in ruins. Further west and north, heavy attrition mounts without immediate territorial changes: Nevish Line, Callahan's Passage, and Stonecradle report sharply accelerating casualty rates under sustained cross-sector engagements, whereas earlier combat across the Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm has settled into quieter artillery duels.
